name: issue-local-draft
description: Selected local bug draft with exact reproduction commands, state and source evidence. Stage test-files/ outside a SKILL.md ancestor, with no network or PR setup; oracle/ and eval.json remain grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs issue-draft.md for export maintainers. Use requirements.md and export.py as evidence. Those files are shared with this audience. Edit only the selected issue-draft.md; do not run the reproduction command.
trap: Turns a reported zero-timeout bug into a verified runtime diagnosis, changes the command or checkbox state, or edits source instead of the selected issue draft.

assertions.text: All applicable reader answers are available in the revised draft alone; explain the user problem before incidental code detail.

Preserve the exact command, invoice-17, ExportKit 2.3.1, macOS 15 arm64, sync-mode condition, 3/3 frequency, expected zero wait versus reported 30 seconds, timeout_ms identifier and all task-checkbox states and links.

Keep source-supported fallback distinct from unexecuted runtime evidence; no invented reproduction, test pass, accepted fix, acceptance criterion or completion. Retain Mina's pending confirmation and asynchronous-export exclusion.
Only issue-draft.md changes in place; source and requirements remain byte-identical, no extra summary/ledger or new draft is created, no reproduction, network or external write occurs.
Full skill/shared instructions load before target/source content, and requirements.md plus export.py are inspected before editing without unrelated investigation or a PR-diff prerequisite.
